tokyo-individual.publisherScope: World Triathlon official event medal table; actual event July 2021, edition 2020.

tokyo-relay.publisherScope: World Triathlon race report identifies team members and medal order.

paris-individual.publisherScope: World Triathlon Olympic podium archive, Paris 2024 individual tables.

paris-relay.publisherScope: World Triathlon identifies relay members; USA silver and GB bronze, not the provisional finish order.

t100-2024-men.publisherScope: World Triathlon confirms overall season title, distinct from Dubai race win.

t100-2024-women.publisherScope: Organizer explicitly identifies Knibb as 2024 T100 World Champion.

t100-2025-men.publisherScope: World Triathlon event is 2025; report explicitly confirms season-long title.

roth-triple.publisherScope: Organizer explicitly lists Ditlev wins 2022–2024; pre-race 2026 article, not evidence of current record after 2026 race.

im-series-2024-women.publisherScope: Official IRONMAN Insider episode 38 description explicitly identifies Kat Matthews as 2024 Pro Series winner. No inference from race position.

dtu-kona24.publisherScope: German federation reports Lange 2024 champion and 7:35:53 course record, Ditlev second; explicitly identifies Lange 2017/2018 titles.

dtu-kona16.publisherScope: German federation confirms Lange bronze and 2:39:45 marathon course best in 2016.

dtu-kona18.publisherScope: German federation identifies Lange 7:52:39 course record and Lucy Charles second in 2018.

aus-kona23.publisherScope: Australian federation lists Charles-Barclay first and Philipp third in 2023 professional women final results.

usa-nice24.publisherScope: US federation confirms Philipp/Matthews/Sodaro podium 2024 and Sodaro 2022 world title.

aus-taupo24.publisherScope: Australian federation confirms Knibb, Matthews, Gentle 2024 70.3 podium and Knibb third consecutive title.

nor-iden21.publisherScope: Norwegian federation release dated 18 September 2021 explicitly confirms Iden 2021 and 2019 70.3 titles.

roth25.publisherScope: Organizer report identifies Laura Philipp and Sam Laidlow as 2025 Roth winners. Also explicitly confirms Hanson Roth marathon course record 2:28:03.

roth26-laidlow.publisherScope: Challenge Family dated 27 July 2026 explicitly confirms Laidlow defended Roth title and reported long-distance world best 7:21:04. Historical organizer claim, not universal ratification.

im25m.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: Nice 2025: Stornes, Iden, Blummenfelt in that order; Stornes championship marathon best 2:29:25.

im25w.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: Kona 2025: Lovseth, Matthews, Philipp; Matthews run-course best 2:47:23. Retrospective explicitly lists Charles-Barclay silver in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2022.

70325w.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: Marbella 2025: Charles-Barclay first, Knibb second; Matthews overall Pro Series champion, distinct from her DNF in this race.

70325m.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: Marbella 2025 podium: Geens, Blummenfelt, Stornes.

70324m.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: Taupo 2024 podium: Geens, Wilde, Bergere.

70326w.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: Nice 2026 podium: Knibb 4:19:24, Derron 4:23:30, Siffert 4:25:10.

70326m.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: Nice 2026 podium: Wilde, Blummenfelt, Geens.

fftri-kona26.publisherScope: French federation final results: men Luis, Iden, Marquardt; women Knibb, Philipp, Derron. Also identifies Laidlow as 2023 champion.

hering24.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: Jackie Hering wins 2024 IRONMAN European Championship Hamburg.

frankfurt24.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: 2025 preview explicitly calls Blummenfelt the 2024 European Champion; not a prediction of 2025 result.

kristian-series25.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: Final 2025 overall Pro Series championship; retrospectively confirms victory at 2025 Frankfurt European Championship.

barnaby-series24.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: Barnaby wins inaugural overall 2024 series, not the Taupo race.

philipp22.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: Philipp 2022 European title and IRONMAN-branded best 8:18:20. Do not generalize to all full-distance races.

stgeorge21.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: 7 May 2022 event is the postponed 2021 edition. Blummenfelt gold, Sanders silver, Matthews silver women.

kona22m.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: 2022 Kona podium Iden, Laidlow, Blummenfelt; Iden marathon 2:36:15, total 7:40:24; Laidlow bike 4:04:36 historical course bests.

70321.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: 2021 final results: Iden/Long/Baekkegard men; Charles-Barclay/Lawrence/Knibb women.

funk-roth.publisherScope: Organizer athlete preview explicitly identifies Funk as 2023 IRONMAN 70.3 runner-up.

bogen-club.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group organizer release confirms Bogen 2023 gold, Funk silver and Stratmann bronze.

nice23m.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: 2023 Nice final podium: Laidlow, Lange, Ditlev.

70322m.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: 2022 final podium: Blummenfelt gold, Kanute silver, Ditlev bronze. Noodt fourth excluded.

70323w.publisherScope: The IRONMAN Group distributed organizer release: 2023 Lahti final podium: Knibb, Matthews, Simmonds.

pallant17im.publisherScope: Organizer 2022 start-list release explicitly identifies Pallant-Browne as 2017 world runner-up.

ath04c-series25-women.publisherScope: IRONMAN organizer release, 9 November 2025: final season standings explicitly list Løvseth second, Perterer third. Reused retained ATH-04B web retrieval; not inferred from race placing.

ath04c-dubai-final.publisherScope: World Triathlon official event authority: dated 17 November 2024; associated event is 2024 T100 Triathlon World Tour Grand Final Dubai, 16–17 November. Confirms Van Riel race first, Bogen race second and season third. Other race placings use existing verified local results.

ath04c-qatar-final.publisherScope: World Triathlon official report dated 12 December 2025 explicitly identifies Qatar T100 World Championship Final in Lusail and winner Wilde. Other finish positions cross-checked against existing local Qatar results. Distinct from ordinary Dubai 2025 race.

ath04c-qatar-organizer.publisherScope: Retained organizer search excerpt explicitly identifies Lusail as host of Qatar Championship Final. Metadata says 2026 but independently dated WT report identifies December 2025. Metadata conflict retained in v1-review; no 2026 award inferred.

ath04c-roth26-local.publisherScope: Existing verified local result; PTO cross-check retained from ATH-04B. Not an organizer result claim.
